submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. The validator body is the one of `Plinth_1.71.0.0_Unisay`, on the older decoder API of the 1.65 line. Compiled with Plinth 1.65.0.0 and the `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` plugin flag. Builtin casing has been a mainnet feature since the van Rossem hard fork (protocol version 11, 2026-07-18); plutus-tx-plugin 1.67 dropped the flag and enables casing under the default `SumsOfProducts`. Emits the batch-6 `dropList` builtin for cursor gaps of three or more fields in the typed decoder (gated behind the same build flag). Inliner budget: `inline-unconditional-growth=12`, kept from revision 1 and not swept again. Source: `lib/TwoPartyEscrow.hs` (+ `lib/Plinth/Decoder.hs`, `lib/Plinth/Decoder/Named.hs`, `lib/Plinth/Encoded.hs`) in plinth-cape-submissions @ 1de61b3a7bda3a0f6a0617e0e99c0877a379728d.
